_pack.name: multi-agent
_pack.description: For agents that hand work to each other. Refuses an action whose argument arrived through a handoff rather than from the session. Measured: with separate sessions a verbatim payload passed from one agent to another was PERMITTED until handoffs were banded, then refused (docs/HANDOFF_RESULT.md). Does NOT catch a payload an agent paraphrased — that launders under every arrangement tested.
_pack.scope: Requires the host to call Guard.handoff() when passing work between agents. A handoff trustband is never told about is a hole, exactly as an unreported tool result is. Start in shadow.
